items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Eddie Williams was playing that band.

ctx.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
ctx.x: Eddie Williams was playing that band.

No, no. Freddie Newroth was playing trumpet. He was the New Orleans man. My brother was playing drums. I was playing trombone. Bill Brady was playing piano. And I don't remember who was playing clarinet. We only had a five piece band. I played with Yellow Nunez too in Chicago. You know Yellow Nunez? Through the records.
